title: NDP Domain Alignment Configuration
description: Schema for cross-stream alignment in domain configurations. Defines how multiple streams are joined for correlation analysis.

granularity.description: Time bucket granularity. Examples: '1 hour', '15 minutes', '1 day'.

stream_role.description: Role of stream in the domain. primary=target variable being optimized, context=environmental data, actuator=potential causes/actions, constraint=limits on actions.

join_strategy.description: SQL join strategy. full_outer=preserve all rows from all streams, left=keep all rows from first (primary) stream, inner=only keep rows where all streams have data.

null_handling.description: NULL handling strategy. preserve=keep NULLs as-is, carry_forward=Last Observation Carried Forward (LOCF), interpolate=linear interpolation (numeric only).

timestamp_alignment.description: Whether bucket timestamp represents start or end of the time period.

stream_reference.description: Reference to a stream for inclusion in the aligned view.

stream_id.description: Reference to an existing stream configuration (stream_id).

alias.description: Short alias for column naming in the aligned view. Must be unique within the domain.

role.description: Role of this stream in the domain.

null_handling.description: Override default NULL handling for this stream.

alignment.description: Alignment configuration for joining multiple streams.

view_name.description: Name for the aligned view. Must be valid PostgreSQL identifier (max 63 chars, lowercase with underscores).

join_strategy.description: How to join streams. Defaults to full_outer.

null_handling.description: Default NULL handling for all streams. Can be overridden per-stream.

timestamp_alignment.description: Whether bucket timestamp is start or end of period. Defaults to bucket_start.
